svg.text: THE PHASE OF EVERY BIN AS AN ARROW; A SHIFT ADDS A RAMP, AND THE RAMP'S SLOPE IS THE POSITION
THE PATCH: ANGLE OF F(KR, KC)
SHIFTED ONE COLUMN RIGHT: EVERY ARROW TURNS −72°·KC
−72° per kc step → column 1; −144° per kr step → row 2
dashed row kr = 0: the edge's own angles
kc = 0 column unchanged; every magnitude unchanged
dotted: the angle before the shift
